593.e2e_note: Initial regression-only e2e (5/5 shell checks) passed. Post-merge standard-mode QA with real opencode agent found 1/5 passed: TC-1 failed (thinking text shown, not joke), TC-2 failed (session title, not prompt), TC-5 failed (no subagent node — deactivated in #586). Root causes: (1) opencode plugin never forwards session.status delta events (zero in telemetry), (2) session.updated EventState::Update doesn't trigger ECE completeWhen (requires Response). Restart cycle addressed each layer: PR #595 (session.updated output detection → Response), PR #597 (output.parts path extraction), PR #598 (find_text_part for DeepSeek multi-part thinking/text outputs). Final cycle: PR #600 (guard empty scalar insertion in normalize_agent_payload to prevent ECE deep-merge overwrite of Init data), PR #599 (reactivate SubagentNode/ToolNode/FileNode creation + tool-use-lifecycle + custom-event contracts — uncommented all FIX-586 deactivated code). Final standard-mode QA: 5/5 passed (user prompt visible, complete agent response, subagent node, tool nodes, no console errors). E2E marker: e2e-9b06af. 366 Rust tests, 220 UI tests all pass.
